---
title: "Scenario trees"
format: html
---

The code in this script reruns the decision tree under four alternative sets of assumptions and saves the annotated trees shown on the [scenario analyses](results_scenarios.qmd) results page. Each scenario changes one or more parameters and leaves every other parameter at its base-case value.

::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}

The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/scenario_trees.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-donor-screening-CEA/blob/master/R/scenario_trees.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.

This R script file is itself reliant on the following helper files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-donor-screening-CEA/blob/master/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-donor-screening-CEA/blob/master/R/functions.R)
:::

```{r}
#| label: read-scripts
#| include: false
#| cache: false
knitr::read_chunk("../R/scenario_trees.R")
```

Each section calls `create_tree_diagram_QC()` with the changed parameters, then exports the tree to SVG, adds the incremental cost, QALYs and net monetary benefit with `add_svg_annotation()`, and saves the result to `figures/`.
